findings.issue: מִקְטַר is a masculine singular construct noun (H4729), not a verb; “quemar” adds the act of burning.
שִׁטִּים is feminine plural absolute; “acacia” is singular.
אֹתוֹ is the direct-object marker with a 3ms suffix; “a él” can be read as a personal or indirect object.

notes: Both forms of עשה stay qal 2ms, and “Y” matches the conjunction on the first.
